title: Jo Maango Wo
body:
baabul hawaij ya abbas
saqqa e ahle haram
ooncha hai jiska alam
kaisa waseela rab ne diya hai
baabe hawaij jisko kaha hai
dunya se lau na lagao
dil ki muradein pao
aao dar e abbas pe aao
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo mil jaayega
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hazrate abbas ka dar hai
jo maango wo mil jaayega
<<DIVIDER>>
apni kismat jagane aajao
apni mannat uthane aajao
dil ka jo haal hai na dil mein rakho
jo bhi gham hai sunane aajao
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab muradein yahan pe paoge
jholiyan apni bhar ke jaoge
kaise mumkin hai na sune ghazi
tum jo faryad le ke jaoge
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
bakht milta hai sikandar ko
bheek milti hai har tawangar ko
ye bulandi hai iske chaukat ki
aasman ne jhuka diya sar ko
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab ghamon ka elaaj hai ye dar
khush naseebi ka taaj hai ye dar
be-zaron ko bana diya buzar
kya sakhawat mizaaj hai ye dar
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaali daaman jo ho khwahar
nek aulaad maang le aakar
ye hai shabbir ka saqi bhai
jitne maango ataa karega pisar
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
barkate rizq ki dua maango
har maraz ki yahan shifa maango
bhool jaoge gham zamane ka
tum ghame shaahe karbala maango
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
zor e baazu shahe madina ka
ye chacha hai usi sakina ka
khaali lauta de ho nahi sakta
waasta do agar sakina ka
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
waasta do rida e zainab ka
pyase bacchon ka maanglo sadqa
waasta de ke bas hussain ka tum
dar pe ghazi ke ek baar zara
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jo kehta hai har ghadi safdar
baat sacchi bhi hai yehi mazhar
sab milega khuloose dil se agar
maula ghazi ke dar pe tum aakar
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
author: Mazhar Abidi
